statement.p: Let \vec{x} = \left[\begin{array}{c} 4\cr 2\cr -1\cr 0 \end{array}\right], \ \vec{y} = \left[\begin{array}{c} -3\cr -1\cr -3.5\cr 1 \end{array}\right], \ \vec{z} = \left[\begin{array}{c} 1\cr 1\cr -4.5\cr -35 \end{array}\right]. Use the Gram-Schmidt process to determine an orthonormal basis for the subspace of {\mathbb R}^4 spanned by \vec{x}, \vec{y}, and \vec{z}.
